recentItems.title: Lady Gaga Welcomes First Baby With Michael Polansky | E! News
recentItems.description:
Lady Gaga welcomed her first baby with fiancé Michael Polansky, according to multiple outlets. Gaga, 40, has not revealed the little one's name or sex. The “Die With a Smile” singer—who got engaged to Michael in July 2024—previously shared insight into her and Michael’s plans to expand their family, saying she envisioned becoming a mom as she reached her 40s. recentItems.title: Shanna Moakler Shares Regret Over Ex Travis Barker's Documentary | E! News
recentItems.description:
Nearly one month after the release of Travis Barker's documentary ‘Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear,’ the former pageant queen shared her regret in participating in the project. "I wish I didn’t do it," Moakler confessed on the Sept. 10 episode of iHeartRadio’s I Do, Part 2 podcast. "I knew in my heart I wasn't going to be portrayed the way that I felt I deserved." While the 51-year-old has not watched the final cut of the Hulu doc—which included appearances from her kids Alabama Barker, 20, Landon Barker, 22, and Atiana De La Hoya, 27, as well as Barker's wife Kourtney Kardashian—she believes it roughly covers the same ground as what the Blink-182 drummer detailed in his 2015 memoir ‘Can I Say.’ "I regretted being a part of that book," Moakler shared. "I didn't like how I was edited or portrayed in that book. It was really, really hurtful." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435995/travis-barkers-ex-wife-shanna-moakler-regrets-being-his-documentary

recentItems.title: Pierce Brosnan Breaks Silence Rumors of Tom Hardy Feud on MobLand | E! News
recentItems.description:
Pierce Brosnan set the record straight on rumors he and MobLand costar Tom Hardy didn’t get along on set. "Oh my God, it was a storm in a teacup, really,” Brosnan told the Press Association in an interview published Sept. 10. "I love the dude. I love Tom Hardy. I'm a massive fan of the man's work. Truly.” The 73-year-old added that he, Hardy and their costar Helen Mirren “are rock solid as a company, as a family.” Hardy—who is set to join his costars for season three of the series that follows warring crime families—echoed his castmate, telling PA that Brosnan and Mirren are “awesome.” The 48-year-old shared, “To be able to work with them is a privilege, but also to be able to enjoy them, watching them spread their wings with their range now as well, and play against their type in some aspects, and really enjoy that is a beautiful thing to watch as a human being.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435984/tom-hardys-mobland-costar-pierce-brosnan-says-theres-no-feud
